exposure: Trial of labor after caesarean delivery (TOLAC)
outcome: Vaginal birth after caesarean delivery (VBAC) rates
cohort: Pregnant women with one previous CD attending antenatal clinics at a tertiary hospital in Nigeria
finding: Despite prior satisfactory caesarean-related birth experiences, antenatal women prefer TOLAC in subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: Women with previous emergency CD were more likely to prefer vaginal delivery.
